chunks: None in this community can be taken at par with the Progeny of Muhammad (peace be upon them),
nor can one who was under their obligation be matched with them.
They are the foundation of religion and the pillar of Belief,
to them the forward runner turns back, and by them the follower overtakes,
they possess the chief characteristics for vicegerency, and in their favor exists the will and succession,
This is the time when right has returned to its owner and diverted to its centre of return.

key_terms.الْغَالِي: The forward runner (one who strives ahead)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia theology according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) establishes the ontological supremacy of the Ahl al-Bayt, declaring them the 'foundation of religion' and the exclusive recipients of divine favor, thereby refuting any attempt to equate them with the rest of the Ummah. The text underscores the concept of *Wilayah* and hereditary succession (*Al-Wasayah*), framing their authority as the return of truth to its rightful owners after a period of concealment or neglect. This serves as a foundational Shia argument for the infallibility and unique spiritual status of the Imams as the pillars of faith.
